newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine president orders probe into rape case.
newsitem.headline: Philippine president orders probe into rape case.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos on Saturday ordered an investigation of five policemen accused of raping a 12-year-old girl, in the latest in a series of high-profile child abuse cases in the Philippines.
Ramos, in a handwritten instruction, ordered police chief Recaredo Sarmiento to look into the matter immediately.
The girl claims she was repeatedly raped over a period of more than a year by the five policemen. The case came to light after the girl's mother allegedly caught two policemen molesting her.
